description: Review items 1.1 + 1.2 (verified): wire mode 'language' in the orchestrator to build_language_system() and give it its own tool list. Today app/agent/orchestrator.py:458 only branches on mode == 'tutor', so 'language' gets the general assistant prompt; app/agent/tools/registry.py keeps the 4 language_* tools inside TUTOR_TOOL_NAMES (line ~169) and checks `mode != "tutor"` at ~393/400/437 (so language mode would also receive MCP tools, the Groq core list and video routing). Independent of the other FEATs (backend agent layer only).
steps: app/agent/tools/registry.py: add `LANGUAGE_TOOL_NAMES = {"language_add_vocabulary", "language_save_pronunciation", "language_add_weak_phoneme", "language_set_level"}` and remove those 4 names from TUTOR_TOOL_NAMES. Add `STUDY_MODES = frozenset({"tutor", "language"})`. In allowed_tool_names: `allowed = set(TUTOR_TOOL_NAMES if mode == "tutor" else LANGUAGE_TOOL_NAMES if mode == "language" else GENERAL_TOOL_NAMES)`; replace every `mode != "tutor"` (MCP add, groq/narrow filter, video routing) with `mode not in STUDY_MODES`. get_tool_declarations already derives from allowed_tool_names, keep that invariant.

app/agent/orchestrator.py: `from app.agent.modes.language import build_language_system`. In _run_llm_with_tools add `elif mode == "language":` right after the tutor branch: `progress = self.language_store.get_progress()`; `system = build_language_system(target_language=progress.get("target_language", "en"), native_language=progress.get("native_language", "pt-BR"), cefr_level=progress.get("cefr_level", "A1"), weak_phonemes=list(progress.get("weak_phonemes") or []), progress_summary=self.language_store.get_summary_for_llm())`. No memory/persona/situational block (same as tutor). Add "language" to the racing exclusion set at ~line 1184. In the two `intent=` expressions (~774, ~883) use `mode if mode in {"tutor", "language"} else "general"`.

app/agent/modes/language.py: reword rule 9 ('Use the whiteboard for grammar patterns...') to 'Use short markdown tables or lists for grammar patterns, verb conjugations and comparisons.' - the language conversation UI renders markdown (MessageContent) and has no whiteboard or whiteboard tools.

app/agent/tools/catalog.py: add TOOL_CATALOG entries next to the whiteboard_* entries, Portuguese text, following that exact ToolMetadata style: language_add_vocabulary (('study','language'), 'low', reversible=True, default_target='vocabulário de idiomas', effect='Adiciona uma palavra ao baralho de vocabulário.', reversibility='Reversível: exclua a palavra na aba Vocabulário.', scope='Só o baralho de vocabulário de idiomas.'), language_save_pronunciation (low, registra tentativa no histórico de pronúncia), language_add_weak_phoneme (low, reversible), language_set_level (low, reversible: defina o nível de volta), tutor_save_progress, tutor_add_flashcard, tutor_save_feynman, enem_save_question (('study','tutor') / ('study','enem'), low, effects in Portuguese). Read the 4 tutor/enem tool classes in app/agent/tools/tutor_tools.py for accurate effect text.

app/agent/tools/inventory.py: import LANGUAGE_TOOL_NAMES, add `"language": tool.name in LANGUAGE_TOOL_NAMES` to each row and show 'idiomas' in the Visível column when row['language'] (after geral/tutor).

New tests/test_language_mode.py: (a) registry built as ToolRegistry(base_folder=tmp, tutor_store=TutorStore(tmp/'t'), language_store=LanguageStore(tmp/'l')); assert allowed_tool_names(mode='language') == set(LANGUAGE_TOOL_NAMES) for provider gemini and groq (user_text 'oi'), equals the declared names from get_tool_declarations, contains no 'mcp_' / whiteboard / system_control, and tutor mode contains no language_* name; (b) prompt routing: build AgentOrchestrator via __new__ like tests/test_situational_context.py (CapturingLLM recording system_instruction, SimpleNamespace registry, isolated_lote6_data fixture, monkeypatched save_session_history/get_session_history/logger/stm_filter) with agent.language_store = SimpleNamespace(get_progress=lambda: {'target_language':'es','cefr_level':'B1','weak_phonemes':['r']}, get_summary_for_llm=lambda: 'Vocabulário: 3'); run handle_request('hola', session_id='s1', mode='language'); assert 'LANGUAGE TUTOR' in system, 'B1' and 'es' and 'Vocabulário: 3' in system, 'Situação agora' not in system; also assert the registry was asked with mode='language' (record kwargs in the SimpleNamespace lambdas).

tests/test_turn_tool_allowlist.py: build the module registry with tutor_store/language_store in tmp dirs; add ('language','gemini','vamos praticar') and ('language','groq','oi') to the parametrize list of test_allowed_names_match_what_the_model_receives; extend test_modes_do_not_share_tools with language (language <= LANGUAGE_TOOL_NAMES, no overlap with general or tutor).

tests/test_tool_catalog.py: add test that every name in TUTOR_TOOL_NAMES | LANGUAGE_TOOL_NAMES registered in a ToolRegistry(tutor_store=..., language_store=..., enem_store=...) built on tmp dirs is in TOOL_CATALOG and its risk_for({}) != 'critical'.
Commit (stage by name): `feat(agent): conecta modo language ao prompt CEFR e isola ferramentas de idiomas`.
acceptance_criteria: Chat with mode='language' uses build_language_system output as system prompt (proved by tests/test_language_mode.py).
allowed_tool_names(mode='language') == the 4 language tools for gemini and groq; tutor mode has none of them; general mode unchanged.
All study-mode tools have TOOL_CATALOG entries, none critical.
